entryNote: Data entry progress counts categories whose data a reviewer has approved; anything still waiting for review counts as partial. It is not inventory coverage — the boundary's coverage is shown below.
nonAuthoritative: On this page, figures that rest on placeholder (demo) or other non-authoritative factors: {count} of {of}, Scope 3 included. They are not authoritative.
overviewNote: Committed activity records. The total is Scope 1 + 2; Scope 3 is recorded but not covered by the inventory. Year-over-year trends arrive once prior-year data exists.
totalScope3Only: Scope 3 is not covered, so this selection has no inventory total

cell.withdrawnMany: Withdrawn entries (not included in the calculation)
cell.uncalculated: {count} of the committed entries here produced no tCO₂e figure. Today that means the category has no emission factor yet.
